summary: Sets flag bits on the entity data struct, copies parameter-table data into per-entity data block 0, starts and resets a high-resolution timer via QueryPerformanceCounter, and zeroes the timer accumulator field. Returns the reset call's value.

operations.description: this[1] := (this[1] & 0xFFFE0FFF) | 0x2000 — mask the flags word at offset 0x4 with 0xFFFE0FFF and set flag bit 0x2000
PerEntityDataBlockCopyFromParameterTable(this, 0, 0) — copy parameter-table data into per-entity data block index 0
TimerStartViaQueryPerformanceCounter(*this) — start the high-resolution timer using the handle stored at offset 0x0
HighResolutionTimerReset(*this) — reset the high-resolution timer using the handle at offset 0x0; its return value becomes result
this[4] := 0 — zero the timer accumulator field at offset 0x10

unresolved: Meaning of the flag bits set/cleared in the flags word at offset 0x4 (mask 0xFFFE0FFF, set bit 0x2000) is unknown.
Semantics of the handle at offset 0x0 used as the timer handle are unknown.
The owning object type is unidentified; the this pointer is a generic _DWORD*.
